description: 국토교통부_일반국도 도로중심선 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 일반국도 도로중심선 정보는 고속국도, 일반국도, 지방도, 시군도 등 전국 도로 중 국토교통부에서 관할하는 일반 국도만을 대상으로 구축한 도로의 중심선 공간 데이터입니다. 노선번호. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
